children: has launched an offering of 25 million global depositary shares, or GDSs, worth up to $1.48 billion, to fund purchases of raw materials in foreign currencies, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters on Monday.
The Taiwanese server manufacturer, an Nvidia
supplier, is offering the GDSs — each representing 10 common shares — at $58.67 to $59.79 per share, according to the sheet.
The range is a 4% to 5.8% discount to Monday's closing price of T$197 ($6.25).
